key_facts: Canada's Defense Investment Agency awarded Telesat a 2.3 billion CAD ($1.6 billion) contract under the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project – Polar (ESCP-P) for Arctic MILSATCOM.
The deal expands Telesat's Lightspeed LEO network from 156 to 225 satellites, with MDA subcontracted to build the new satellites.
MILSATCOM services to the Canadian Armed Forces, covering 65 to 90 degrees North latitude, are scheduled to begin in 2028.
A future phase of ESCP-P involves negotiations for a UHF/X-band constellation in medium Earth orbit, with MDA Space as prime contractor and Telesat as subcontractor.
Telesat says all 225 satellites will have 4 optical intersatellite links compliant with the US Space Development Agency's standard, creating a self-healing mesh network.
